_notice: G12-10 execution window artifact. Records the authorized execution parameters for ICT-EXP-001. This artifact DOES NOT grant execution authority — that requires separate human approval at G12-8 clearance (currently NOT_GRANTED). Window defines WHEN and HOW execution may proceed once clearance is granted.

execution_window.clearance_prerequisite: G12-8 destructive_test_clearance must transition from NOT_GRANTED to GRANTED before any execution
execution_window.freeze_prerequisite: G12-9 freeze_approval must transition from PENDING_HUMAN_APPROVAL to APPROVED
execution_window.rollback_policy: Immediate halt on any unhandled exception, data integrity violation, or embargo breach. All partial results quarantined, not published.
execution_window.monitoring: Real-time log streaming to study owner; automated anomaly detection on containment metrics
